complicacoes.texto: His magnetic Powers slowly sap Neal Emerson’s Prontidão and Vontade. He is also susceptible to Telepatia Powers.
Doctor Polaris is basically a living magnet, and as such he functions like one, losing his “charge” when exposed to extreme Calor, recharging with kinetic energy, susceptible to magnetic fields, etc.
Doctor Polaris is a second personality within Neal Emerson. Both personalities wrestle for control.
